topics: Complex Numbers: Algebra, forms, D’Moivre’s Theorem, expansion of trigonometric functions.
Hyperbolic Functions: Circular functions, inverse functions, real and imaginary parts.
Logarithms of Complex Numbers: Basic concepts and simple examples.
Partial Differentiation: First and higher order derivatives, composite functions, Euler’s Theorem.
Applications of Partial Differentiation: Maxima, Minima, successive differentiation, Leibnitz’s Theorem.
Matrices: Types, properties, rank using Echelon form, system of equations.
Numerical Solutions: Transcendental equations via Newton Raphson and Regula–Falsi.
System of Linear Equations: Gauss Jacobi and Gauss Seidel Iteration Methods.
Lasers: Spontaneous, stimulated emission, population inversion, resonant cavity, coherence.
He-Ne and Fiber laser construction and working principles.
Laser Applications: LiDAR, Barcode reading, metal work processing.
Fibre Optics: Critical angle, acceptance angle, numerical aperture, total internal reflection.
Optical Fiber Types: Single mode, multimode, step index, graded index.
Fiber Optic Communication System: Attenuation, advantages and applications.
Interference in Thin Films: Uniform thickness, wedge shaped film, Newton’s rings.
Thin Film Applications: Wavelength determination, refractive index, anti-reflecting coating.
Electrodynamics: Vector calculus, Gauss’s, Ampere’s, Faraday’s laws.
Maxwell’s equations in point and integral form and their significance.
Quantum Physics: de Broglie hypothesis, matter waves, wave function.
Schrödinger’s equations, particle in a rigid box, quantum mechanical tunneling.
Quantum Computing Principles: Concept of Qubit and its applications.
Semiconductor Physics: Direct and Indirect Band Gap Semiconductors, Electrical Conductivity.
Drift Velocity, Mobility, Conductivity in conductors, Fermi-Dirac distribution function.
Fermi Level Position: Intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductors.
